# telnyx_dynamic_emergency_address (Resource)

An address for dynamic emergency calling. Addresses cannot be changed; a new value replaces the address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Addresses cannot be changed, so every change replaces the address.
resource "telnyx_dynamic_emergency_address" "example" {
  house_number        = "600"
  street_name         = "Congress"
  street_suffix       = "Ave"
  extended_address    = "Suite 200"
  locality            = "Austin"
  administrative_area = "TX"
  postal_code         = "78701"
  country_code        = "US"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `administrative_area` (String)
- `country_code` (String) One of `CA`, `PR`, `US`.
- `house_number` (String)
- `locality` (String)
- `postal_code` (String)
- `street_name` (String)

### Optional

- `extended_address` (String)
- `house_suffix` (String)
- `street_post_directional` (String)
- `street_pre_directional` (String)
- `street_suffix` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the resource was created
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `sip_geolocation_id` (String) Unique location reference string to be used in SIP INVITE from / p-asserted headers.
- `status` (String) Status of dynamic emergency address
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the resource was last updated

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_dynamic_emergency_address.example <id>
```
